always.frogid_wording: Use cross-dataset consistency / directional agreement across two monitoring datasets. Do not call the continuous-depth analysis an independent test or external validation.
always.sorensen_title: Remove without practical homogenization from the title. Keep post hoc practical-equivalence as a secondary bounded result in Results/Discussion.
always.worldwide_wording: Do not claim worldwide, universal or global generality.

if_strong_rejection_and_boundary_above_p.title: Rainfall-associated expansion of frog active communities is more boundary-biased than uniform activation predicts
if_strong_rejection_and_boundary_above_p.main_interpretation: The allocation departure survives a persistence-favouring null, strengthening the claim that uniform amplification does not reproduce where additional participation enters the matrix.
if_strong_rejection_and_boundary_above_p.discussion: May discuss preferential recruitment of combinations rare in dry conditions and temporary/intermittent wet-site activation as plausible hypotheses, explicitly non-causal.

if_primary_rejects_but_not_strong.title: Rainfall-associated expansion of frog active communities departs from uniform activation
if_primary_rejects_but_not_strong.main_interpretation: Structured departure is retained but persistence sensitivity is qualified.

if_primary_does_not_reject.title: Rainfall-associated expansion of frog active communities across spatial and taxonomic scales
if_primary_does_not_reject.main_interpretation: Do not claim allocation beyond uniform activation as a robust headline; retain original null as model-dependent evidence.
